What we know
 Taylor Ardrey USA TODAY Updated Nov. 3, 2026, 10:01 a.m. ET Hear this story Millions of people nationwide are preparing to cast their vote in the 2026 midterm elections. 
 Outside of heading to their designated polling sites on Tuesday, Nov. 3, many people still have other things on their to-do list, including going to the bank or post office.
 So, what's open or closed on Election Day? Here's what we know.
 2026 Midterm Election: When will we know the results? Details on the process Is Election Day considered a federal holiday?
 No, Election Day is not considered a federal holiday .
 Is the post office open on Election Day?
 Yes, U.S. post offices will be open.
 Will shipping services, like UPS and FedEx, be available on Election Day?
 Yes. UPS and FedEx shipping services will be available as usual.
